properties.sql-pre-query:
UPDATE	QT 
FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE QT, 
(
	select qq.* 	
	from
	(
							SELect Q.*
							FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE Q
							WHERE Q.TGT_TABLE_STATE = 0	
							AND  not EXISTS (
															SELECT 1 
															FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE x 
															WHERE ( x.TGT_TABLE_STATE > 0 and x.TGT_TABLE_STATE < 3) 
															AND x.TGT_TABLE = Q.TGT_TABLE AND x.TGT_LAYER = Q.TGT_LAYER
															) 
															
							and not exists (SELECT *
	  									FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.V_EXEC_PROCESS_LOGS l
	 									WHERE l.RUN_ID 			=   Q.RUN_ID
										and l.SOURCE_NAME		 =   Q.SOURCE_NAME
										and l.LOAD_ID 					=   Q.LOAD_ID
										and l.LAYER_LEVEL 			<   Q.LAYER_LEVEL		
										and l.ERROR_CODE 		<>  0
										)
							QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER()  OVER(PARTITION BY Q.TGT_LAYER, Q.TGT_TABLE  ORDER BY Q.LAST_UPDATE_TIME, Q.LAYER_LEVEL, Q.SOURCE_NAME)=1

	)  qq
	where not exists (select 1 
								from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE lvl 
								where lvl.RUN_ID 					=   qq.RUN_ID
								and lvl.SOURCE_NAME		 =   qq.SOURCE_NAME
								and lvl.LAYER_LEVEL 		<   qq.LAYER_LEVEL
								and lvl.TGT_TABLE_STATE < 3
								
								)

	QUALIFY dense_rank()  OVER(PARTITION BY qq.SOURCE_NAME  ORDER BY qq.LAYER_LEVEL)=1
) x
SET TGT_TABLE_STATE 			= 1
, LAST_UPDATE_TIME 				= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE X.TGT_TABLE				= QT.TGT_TABLE
	AND X.TGT_LAYER					= QT.TGT_LAYER
	AND X.RUN_ID					= QT.RUN_ID
	AND X.SOURCE_NAME				= QT.SOURCE_NAME
	AND X.LOAD_ID					= QT.LOAD_ID
	AND QT.TGT_TABLE_STATE			= QT.TGT_TABLE_STATE;
properties.SQL select query:
SEL DISTINCT 
	Q.TGT_LAYER, Q.TGT_TABLE, Q.SOURCE_NAME, Q.LOAD_ID, Q.OVERRIDE_LOAD, Q.RUN_ID,
	(SELECT COUNT(1) 
		FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.PROCESS P 
		WHERE P.TGT_LAYER=Q.TGT_LAYER 
		and P.TGT_TABLE=Q.TGT_TABLE 
		and P.SOURCE_NAME=Q.SOURCE_NAME 
	) CNT_PROCESSES
FROM  ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE	 Q
	
WHERE Q.TGT_TABLE_STATE = 1
ORDER BY CNT_PROCESSES DESC;

properties.SQL select query:
update ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SCRIPT_LOGS
set ERROR_CODE = -1, ERROR_MSG = 'ABORT', END_TIMESTAMP = current_timestamp
where END_TIMESTAMP is null
and RUN_ID <> ( select distinct run_id from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE);

update ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_PROCESS_LOGS
set ERROR_CODE = -1, ERROR_MSG = 'ABORT', END_TIMESTAMP = current_timestamp
where END_TIMESTAMP is null
and RUN_ID <> ( select distinct run_id from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE);

update ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SOURCE_LOGS
set ERROR_CODE = -1, ERROR_MSG = 'ABORT', END_TIMESTAMP = current_timestamp, DONE = 1
where (END_TIMESTAMP is null or DONE = 0)
and RUN_ID <> ( select distinct run_id from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE);

UPDATE TGT 
FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SOURCE_LOGS TGT, ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.V_EXEC_SOURCE_LOAD_LOGS SRC
SET 
	 STG_DONE =  LAYER_DONE
	,ERROR_CODE = LAST_ERROR_CODE
	,ERROR_MSG = LAST_ERROR_MSG
WHERE SRC.RUN_ID = TGT.RUN_ID
AND SRC.LOAD_ID = TGT.LOAD_ID
AND SRC.SOURCE_NAME = TGT.SOURCE_NAME
AND SRC.LAYER_NAME = 'STG'
AND (TGT.END_TIMESTAMP IS NULL OR TGT.DONE = 0)
AND STG_DONE <>  LAYER_DONE;

UPDATE TGT 
FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SOURCE_LOGS TGT, ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.V_EXEC_SOURCE_LOAD_LOGS SRC
SET 
	 BKEY_DONE =  LAYER_DONE
	,ERROR_CODE = LAST_ERROR_CODE
	,ERROR_MSG = LAST_ERROR_MSG
WHERE SRC.RUN_ID = TGT.RUN_ID
AND SRC.LOAD_ID = TGT.LOAD_ID
AND SRC.SOURCE_NAME = TGT.SOURCE_NAME
AND SRC.LAYER_NAME = 'BKEY'
AND (TGT.END_TIMESTAMP IS NULL OR TGT.DONE = 0)
and BKEY_DONE <> LAYER_DONE;

UPDATE TGT 
FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SOURCE_LOGS TGT, ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.V_EXEC_SOURCE_LOAD_LOGS SRC
SET 
	 SRCI_DONE =  LAYER_DONE
	,ERROR_CODE = LAST_ERROR_CODE
	,ERROR_MSG = LAST_ERROR_MSG
WHERE SRC.RUN_ID = TGT.RUN_ID
AND SRC.LOAD_ID = TGT.LOAD_ID
AND SRC.SOURCE_NAME = TGT.SOURCE_NAME
AND SRC.LAYER_NAME = 'SRCI'
AND (TGT.END_TIMESTAMP IS NULL OR TGT.DONE = 0)
and SRCI_DONE <> LAYER_DONE;

UPDATE TGT 
FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SOURCE_LOGS TGT, ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.V_EXEC_SOURCE_LOAD_LOGS SRC
SET 
	 CORE_DONE =  LAYER_DONE
	,ERROR_CODE = LAST_ERROR_CODE
	,ERROR_MSG = LAST_ERROR_MSG
WHERE SRC.RUN_ID = TGT.RUN_ID
AND SRC.LOAD_ID = TGT.LOAD_ID
AND SRC.SOURCE_NAME = TGT.SOURCE_NAME
AND SRC.LAYER_NAME = 'CORE'
AND (TGT.END_TIMESTAMP IS NULL OR TGT.DONE = 0)
and CORE_DONE <> LAYER_DONE;

UPDATE TGT 
FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SOURCE_LOGS TGT, 
(
			select RUN_ID,  LOAD_ID, SOURCE_NAME
			
			, 	SUM(ROWS_INSERTED_COUNT) 		ROWS_INSERTED_COUNT
			,	sum(ROWS_UPDATED_COUNT) 		ROWS_UPDATED_COUNT
			,	sum(ROWS_DELETED_COUNT) 		ROWS_DELETED_COUNT
			from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.V_EXEC_SOURCE_LOAD_LOGS 
			group by RUN_ID,  LOAD_ID, SOURCE_NAME
			having SUM(case when PRECEDING_LAYER_DONE = 1 and PRECEDING_FAILED_CNT > 0 then 0 else CNT_PROCESSES end) = sum(passed) + sum(failed)
) SRC
SET 
	ROWS_INSERTED_COUNT = src.ROWS_INSERTED_COUNT
	,ROWS_UPDATED_COUNT = src.ROWS_UPDATED_COUNT
	,ROWS_DELETED_COUNT = src.ROWS_DELETED_COUNT
	,DONE =  1
	,END_TIMESTAMP = current_timestamp
WHERE SRC.RUN_ID = TGT.RUN_ID
AND SRC.LOAD_ID = TGT.LOAD_ID
AND SRC.SOURCE_NAME = TGT.SOURCE_NAME
AND (TGT.END_TIMESTAMP IS NULL OR TGT.DONE = 0);

update tgt
from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.CDC_AUDIT tgt, ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SOURCE_LOGS src
set PROCESSED = 1, UPDATED_BY = user, UPDATED_AT=current_timestamp
where SRC.LOAD_ID = TGT.LOAD_ID
AND SRC.SOURCE_NAME = TGT.SOURCE_NAME
and src.DONE = 1
and src.ERROR_CODE = 0
and tgt.PROCESSED = 0;

properties.new_wave_query:
with 
latest_run as 
 (select top 1 RUN_ID from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_RUN_LOGS)
, SRC_ONE_LOAD_ID as (

	select a.SOURCE_NAME, a.LOAD_ID, a.batch_id
	from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.cdc_audit a
	where exists (select 1 from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.SOURCE_SYSTEMS P where p.SOURCE_NAME = a.SOURCE_NAME and p.ACTIVE=1 and p.IS_SCHEDULED = 1 and p.loading_mode = 'ONLINE')
	and a.PROCESSED=0
	and a.valid_batch=1
	qualify ROW_NUMBER() OVER (Partition by SOURCE_NAME order by  batch_id) = 1
	
	UNION ALL
	
	select P.SOURCE_NAME, P.SOURCE_NAME LOAD_ID, 0 batch_id
	from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.SOURCE_SYSTEMS P where p.ACTIVE=1 and p.IS_SCHEDULED = 1 and p.loading_mode = 'OFFLINE'
)
, TGT_TABLES AS
(
		SELECT DISTINCT 						
		  p.TGT_TABLE 
		, p.TGT_LAYER
		, l.layer_Level
		, p.SOURCE_NAME
						
 FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.V_PROCESS P
 join ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.LAYERS l
 on p.TGT_LAYER = l.layer_name
	WHERE ACTIVE = 1
)
SELECT
T.TGT_TABLE
,T.TGT_LAYER
,T.LAYER_LEVEL
,T.SOURCE_NAME
,r.RUN_ID
,0 TGT_TABLE_STATE
,L.LOAD_ID
,0 OVERRIDE_LOAD
,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP		LAST_UPDATE_TIME		
FROM TGT_TABLES T, SRC_ONE_LOAD_ID L, latest_run r
WHERE T.SOURCE_NAME=L.SOURCE_NAME
and not exists (
							select	1 
							from	${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SOURCE_LOGS x 
							where	 x.DONE = 1
							and x.run_id = r.RUN_ID 
							and x.source_name = T.SOURCE_NAME 
							and x.load_id = L.LOAD_ID 
						)
						
		and not exists (
							select 1 
							from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE x
							where x.run_id = r.RUN_ID 
							and x.source_name = T.SOURCE_NAME 
							and x.load_id = L.LOAD_ID 
							and x.TGT_LAYER = t.TGT_LAYER
							and x.TGT_TABLE = t.TGT_TABLE
							)

properties.sql-post-query:
INSERT	INTO ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SOURCE_LOGS
(RUN_ID, LOAD_ID, SOURCE_NAME, START_TIMESTAMP, END_TIMESTAMP,
STG_DONE, BKEY_DONE, SRCI_DONE, CORE_DONE, DONE
,ROWS_INSERTED_COUNT,ROWS_UPDATED_COUNT, ROWS_DELETED_COUNT, ERROR_CODE, ERROR_MSG
)
SELect
distinct
RUN_ID, LOAD_ID, SOURCE_NAME, current_timestamp START_TIMESTAMP, null END_TIMESTAMP,
		0 STG_DONE, 0 BKEY_DONE, 0 SRCI_DONE, 0 CORE_DONE, 0 DONE
		, null ROWS_INSERTED_COUNT, null  ROWS_UPDATED_COUNT, null  ROWS_DELETED_COUNT,
		null  ERROR_CODE, null  ERROR_MSG
FROM ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE src
where not exists (select 1 from ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_SOURCE_LOGS tgt where src.RUN_ID=tgt.RUN_ID and src.LOAD_ID=tgt.LOAD_ID and src.SOURCE_NAME=tgt.SOURCE_NAME);

properties.sql-pre-query:
CALL GPROD1_ETL.CDC_AUDIT_LOADING(${v_run_id}, A,B,C,D);

CREATE MULTISET TABLE ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.EXEC_RUN_LOGS ,no FALLBACK ,
     NO BEFORE JOURNAL,
     NO AFTER JOURNAL,
     CHECKSUM = DEFAULT,
     DEFAULT MERGEBLOCKRATIO,
     MAP = TD_MAP1
     (      RUN_ID BIGINT NOT NULL  )
PRIMARY INDEX ( RUN_ID );
properties.SQL select query:
CREATE SET TABLE ${CONFIG_SCHEMA}.TGT_TABLES_QUEUE ,FALLBACK ,
     NO BEFORE JOURNAL,
     NO AFTER JOURNAL,
     CHECKSUM = DEFAULT,
     DEFAULT MERGEBLOCKRATIO,
     MAP = TD_MAP1
     (
       TGT_TABLE VARCHAR(200) CHARACTER SET LATIN NOT CASESPECIFIC NOT NULL
	  ,TGT_LAYER VARCHAR(200) CHARACTER SET LATIN NOT CASESPECIFIC NOT NULL
	  ,LAYER_LEVEL integer not null
	  ,SOURCE_NAME VARCHAR(100) CHARACTER SET LATIN NOT CASESPECIFIC NOT NULL
	  ,RUN_ID BIGINT NOT NULL
      ,TGT_TABLE_STATE INTEGER DEFAULT 0 
      ,LOAD_ID VARCHAR(200) CHARACTER SET LATIN NOT CASESPECIFIC NOT NULL
      ,OVERRIDE_LOAD INTEGER DEFAULT 0 
      ,LAST_UPDATE_TIME TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
	  , check (
					TGT_TABLE_STATE = 0 /* ready to be queued */
				or 	TGT_TABLE_STATE = 1 /* queued */
				or 	TGT_TABLE_STATE = 2 /* dispatched */
				or 	TGT_TABLE_STATE = 3 /* processed */
				
			)
	  )
UNIQUE PRIMARY INDEX ( TGT_TABLE ,TGT_LAYER ,RUN_ID , LOAD_ID);
